description: PAID: current conditions, the next 12 hourly steps and up to 7 daily rows for one point, for $0.0100. Coordinates only, no place names; data from MET Norway (api.met.no), attribution rides in the answer. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Sei or X Layer) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

days.description: Daily rows (UTC dates) to return, 1..7. Omitted means 3. Same price.
